behavioral_effects: Coding workspaces can name git://host.docker.internal:9418/<dir>/<repo> and the attach-time briefing tells the model the URL, so the first turn can clone without being pasted it
Dev sandbox commands get 300s client-side, matching sandboxd's execute timeout, so a backend pytest run is no longer cut off mid-command
compatibility_impact: repo_url validation widened (accepts git:// in addition to http/https) — strictly additive; read_repository_briefing gains a keyword-only repo_url param defaulting to None; briefing text now includes the workspace repo_url when set. No HTTP contract shape change
follow_up: Fix the services.json extractor to parse volume short syntax containing \ (and long syntax, per the standing follow-up), then restore the HOST_REPOS_ROOT override
Run the phase-2 bootstrap smoke: workspace fullstack-self against the daemon URL, confirm briefing carries the URL end-to-end and files persist across turns
limitations: HOST_REPOS_ROOT env override omitted: the services.json extractor mis-parses \ volume short syntax into a garbage named-volume entry, so the bind is the literal ../.. until the extractor is fixed
App container not yet recreated; SANDBOX_TIMEOUT_SECS=300 takes effect on next compose up of app (phase-2 bring-up)
reason: The coding sandbox has no path to a repository: workspace repo_url rejects git://, the agent is never told the URL, and the 60s client timeout kills long commands. A loopback git daemon over the dev bridge (ADR-006 rule 7 egress already granted in dev; recorded as a note on rule 7 / open question 1) plus these three client-side fixes completes the local bootstrap loop without any GitHub credential in the product.
risks: Any local container, not only the sandbox, can read every repository under the mounted root; accepted and documented as dev-machine posture in the ADR rule 7 note
rollback: git revert restores validation, briefing, compose, and ADR text. A revert does not restore: the built fullstack-git-daemon:local image and the running fullstack-git-local-1 container (docker compose --profile coding down git-local and docker rmi remove them), and the app container still needs a recreate to pick SANDBOX_TIMEOUT_SECS=300 up (or drop it) either way
security_impact: Dev-only anonymous git daemon on 127.0.0.1:9418 exports the host Repositories root read to any local container via host.docker.internal; write surface enforced in-image to new refs/heads/sandbox/* only, and pushes cannot execute repository-owned hooks (hooksPath shadowing). git:// added to repo_url allowlist carries no credentials, so connection-urls-are-stripped posture is unchanged; ssh:// deliberately still excluded. Base and prod stacks: no service, runtime has no network to reach one
summary: Add a dev-profile git daemon so coding sandboxes can clone and push the host repos

all stacks+profiles config --quiet, includes prod with validation dummies
exit 0, 10 files, 61 tests; no frontend change (repo_url input has no client-side scheme gate)

one Medium finding confirmed at 8/10 (declared sandbox/* write surface was unenforced and the host gateway is reachable from every local container) and remediated in-session: update hook admits only new refs/heads/sandbox/*, denyDeletes+denyNonFastForwards, core.hooksPath shadows per-repo hooks; live-verified sandbox push OK, evil-branch push refused, deletion refused. Whole-root anonymous read accepted as documented dev posture
